name: Advanced Modding Lights
teaser: Enhance the lighting in weapon modding and build screens for better visibility and aesthetics
description_html:
Enhance the lighting in weapon modding and build screens for better realism and control. It’s good for controlling the lighting when taking screenshots. It activates a directional light which creates more reflections on the angles you choose.

Features

  • Enhanced Lighting: Improves lighting in weapon modding and build screens
  • Configurable Settings: Adjust directional light brightness and rotation
  • Real-time Updates: Settings apply immediately without restart
  • Performance Optimized: Efficient light caching and management

Installation

  • Download the latest release
  • Extract to your SPT folder
  • Configure settings via F12 (Config Manager)

Configuration Options

  • Enable Custom Lighting: Toggle enhanced lighting on/off
  • Brightness: Control directional light intensity (0.1 - 5.0)
  • Rotation X/Y: Adjust light direction (-180° to 180°)

For feature requests and reporting bugs, please use the GitHub repo for this mod
